issues.issue: Printed only as 'Local Receipts: Other'; treating the utility funds' only receipt line as utility charges is an assumption, not printed.
Printed row label is Public Works - Other; category taken from the Park Fund column instead of the row. Defensible, but it doesn't match the label.

issues.on_page: Electric Utility 8,513.23 General + 684.85 Park (p4) + 789.52 Volunteer Fire Dept. (p5), under Business-Type Activities
issues.issue: Governmental funds paying lines on the business-type 'Electric Utility' row are most likely electricity bills, not a utility function. Category utilities and fund type governmental are judgment calls.

issues.on_page: Transportation 12,553.28 (General 8,056.19 + Volunteer Fire Dept. 4,497.09), under Business-Type Activities
issues.issue: The function is unclear (could be streets/highways or vehicle costs); 'other' is defensible but doubtful.
